rule: Bars crossing the colour-6 line keep their columns and colours. Their vertical extents (top, bottom) are sorted by length and reassigned from left to right, shortest first.
scope: Supported: grid sizes 5..30 per side, a random line row, 3..6 bars of width 1..3, random gaps including adjacent bars of different colours, repeated colours on non-adjacent bars, centred or off-centre extents, and an optional transposed layout. Not supported: multiple lines, bars that do not cross the line, bars touching the grid edge vertically, and equal-length extents that sit at different offsets (that case would be ambiguous).
constraints: background is 8 and the line is 6; bar colours are never 6 or 8
every bar extent contains the line row and stays within rows 1..H-2, so no column fills completely and the transpose detection is unambiguous
adjacent bars (gap 0) have different colours, so line-row runs identify the groups
colour 6 is the strict majority on the line row
two extents with the same length are identical, so ties never cause ambiguity
the input extents are not already sorted, so the output never equals the input
known_limitations: The transposed layout never appears in the original fixtures. It is sampled with 20% probability because the explained program handles it.
The background and line colours are fixed at 8 and 6, as in every fixture.
Bounded sampling raises instead of substituting a fixed scene.
billing: Claude Max CLI; API credentials excluded; no API fallback
